questions.questionHtml:
Given below are four sentences, three of which are jumbled. Pick the option that gives the correct order.

A. Two brothers lived in a town in Persia, one named Cassim, and the other Ali Baba.

B. He was afraid that they were robbers and climbed onto a tree for safety.

C. One day, when Ali Baba was in the forest, he saw a troop of men on horseback, coming toward him in a cloud of dust.

D. Cassim was married to a rich wife and lived in luxury, while Ali Baba had to maintain his wife and children by cutting wood in a neighboring forest and selling it in the town.
questions.solution:
The correct sequence of sentences is ADCB. A begins the paragraph by telling us about the two brothers, Cassim and Alibaba, who lived in a town in Persia. D follows A to tell us more about the brothers: Cassim led a luxurious life, while Ali Baba had to work hard cutting wood in a neighbouring forest and selling it in the town to make a living. C follows D to tell us that one day, when Ali Baba was in the forest, he saw a group of horsemen coming towards him. B concludes the paragraph by telling us that Ali Baba got scared upon seeing them, believing they were robbers and climbed up a tree for safety. Thus, B is the right answer.
